title: Smoking Kills
start: Talk to Sumona in her house in Pollnivneach.

items.t: Ranged/Magic/Necromancy weapons or spells (must kill skeletons without melee)
Kitten, cat, overgrown cat, hellcat, wily cat, or lazy cat

recommended.t: Desert heat protection (completing Crocodile Tears grants immunity)
Player-owned house in Pollnivneach, Pollnivneach Teleport scroll or a few coins for Magic carpet rides
Ring of slaying (for teleportation to Pollnivneach)
Rope (if you haven't completed Dealing with Scabaras and have at least 40 Agility)

rewards.t: Ability to earn the full amount of Slayer points for completing Slayer tasks
Access to the Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon and Tomb of Catolax
Ability to craft slayer helmets and full slayer helmets if the prerequisite unlock has been purchased
Access to the Desert Slayer Dungeon miniquest

steps.t: Head to Pollnivneach. You can use the magic carpet network from Shantay Pass or Al Kharid lodestone to travel to Al Kharid and head south-east or Teleport to your player owned house and exit via Pollniveach.
Speak to Sumona in Pollnivneach [Chat: Accept] (without a cat pet out).
Equip your catspeak amulet.
Run south to the well in the town centre.
Attempt to climb down the well.
Speak to the cat, finish all prompts.

sub.t: If you do not wear a catspeak amulet or skip the conversation, you will be unable to open the sealed tomb door later in the quest.

steps.t: Travel to Sophanem by either one of the following methods.

sub.t: Menaphos lodestone teleport, then run east across the bridge to Sophanem (requires completion of The Jack of Spades and Contact!)

p: A Scabaras lancer, crocodile, and Locust lancer in the swamp

steps.t: Head southeast towards the sea/swampland
Enter the swamp using the entrance at the south end of the swamp, by the seashore.
Make your way to the north-west part of the swamp, "climb fallen pillar", and go up the stairs.

sub.t: Optional: Go west, "climb low wall", use your rope on the "rock", jutting out over the edge - this will give you quicker access in the future.

steps.t: Walk north past the archaeologist's fire, through the opening between the cliffs.
Search the western wall for a sealed door to enter the dungeon.
Drop your cat, search the western "holey wall". Agree, and your cat will enter, opening the wall.
Go west, kill (or ignore) the 3 skeletons to the south with magic/range/necromancy.
Destroy the broken door until you can walk through it.
Search the west wall (not the odd markings on the east wall) twice to temporarily disable and pass two traps.
Enter the door to the north.
Kill the zombies and skeletons.
After about 10-20 seconds, a level 77 mummy warrior will spawn. Kill it and take the plink | Ranged path key .
Open the door to the east, pull the lever on the northern wall.
Return to the starting room (traps on this side are now permanently disabled)
Repeat steps on the other side.

sub.t: Go east, kill (or ignore) the 3 skeletons to the south with magic/range/necro.
Search the east wall (not odd markings on the west wall) twice to disable and pass two traps.
Enter the door to the north.
After about 10-20 seconds, a level 77 mummy warrior will spawn. Kill it and take the plink | Magic path key .
Use the key on the door to the west, pull the lever on the northern wall.

steps.t: Return to the starting room (traps on this side are now permanently disabled).
Walk north, all traps have been disabled and can be ignored.
Equip your plink | Ghostspeak amulet and talk to Catolax.
Use your plink | Earmuffs on your plink | Face mask to create plink | Masked earmuffs .
Return to Pollnivneach.
Equip your masked earmuffs and combat gear.
Enter the well in the town centre.
Head north, kill a mighty banshee to get a plink | Banshee voice . The drop must be manually picked up; it will not appear in the area loot interface.
Ensure any follower is dismissed and auto-retaliate is turned off first, then run all the way north to the large blue/purple wavering mystic barrier and pass through it.

sub.t: Do not click on anything else while the cutscene is in motion, or you will go back outside the barrier and will need to acquire another banshee voice.

p: Uh oh, time for a fight!

steps.t: After the cutscene, attack the Banshee mistress. She is weak to bolts, so using range is recommended if you're lower-levelled.

sub.t: Enable the Protect from Ranged prayer after she gets to 50% health.

p: Jesmona destroys the book and the Insectoid assassins.

steps.t: Finish the fight and watch the cutscene.

sub.t: If you click on anything else, you will go outside the barrier, but you will not have to fight again; you can easily go back inside the barrier to continue the last cutscene.

steps.t: Return to Pollnivneach (you can climb out of the well).
Pick up your cat if you have not already done so.
Talk to Sumona again to complete the quest.

get_inside.text: Northern side of the town with a magic carpet, house portal and a small obelisk
pic: Northern side of the town with a magic carpet, house portal and a small obelisk

get_inside.text: Pollnivneach Teleport scroll takes user directly into the city.
Using the magic carpet network to one of two magic carpet stations in the city. South Pollnivneach is also one of the two destinations of the Monkey colony magic carpet route.
House Teleport, if players have their house portal in Pollnivneach, they can use the spell to reach their house and then exit through the portal.
Pollnivneach tablet, if the Love Story quest has been completed.
Ring of slaying, Slayer cape or Slayer master cape teleport to the house of slayer master Sumona.
The Mask of Mourning and Helm of Keening can teleport user to the Pollnivneach well.
The master camouflage outfit offers unlimited teleports to Pollnivneach, just north-east of the well.
Walking south/south-east from the Shantay Pass.
Using the ferryman, Portmaster Kags, in the south-western corner of the Menaphos Port district.
Other ways to reach the city indirectly. These methods first go to nearby locations to speed up the journey, and then use the above methods to reach Pollnivneach:

There are some fairy rings somewhat near Pollnivneach. Ring DLQ is in the Uzer Hunter area near Nardah; from there either use the Nardah carpet or walk north-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and then walk south-west to the city. Ring BIQ is near the entrance to the Kalphite Lair; from there use the Shantay Pass carpet or walk east/south-east to the city.

The eagle transport system flies to a cave near the Uzer Hunter area, like the fairy ring DLQ. From there, either walk south-east to Uzer and use the carpet, or walk south-west to the upper river bridge, cross it and walk south-west to Pollnivneach.
The Dorgesh-Kaan shortcut in the dungeon beneath the agility course leads to the Kalphite Lair and from there has the same routes as Fairy Ring code BIQ.
The camulet from Enakhra's Lament teleports to the underground Enakhra's Temple. Climb out from there and walk east to the city.

The Pharaoh's sceptre from the Pyramid Plunder minigame teleports to any of three pyramids: Jalsavrah Pyramid is in Sophanem; from there take the carpet or walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaleustrophos Pyramid is the Agility Pyramid; from there either walk northeast to Nardah and take the carpet, or walk north-west to the lower river bridge, cross it and walk north to Pollnivneach. Jaldraocht Pyramid is also called Azzanadra's pyramid from the Desert Treasure quest; from there walk east or northeast to Pollnivneach.
